name: 4WD_ONLY_SYMBOL_YELLOW_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet WS111 (warning-series symbol): 4WD 80 D (210 wide) baseline 140, ONLY 80 D (271) baseline 290. Layout: 350 x 350, yellow, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): 4WD 80 D top 60 x 71-280 (209); ONLY 80 D top 210 x 39-310 (271).
